title: clinopodium dentatum
intro: Clinopodium dentatum, commonly known as Kukui, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. It is native to Hawaii and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Clinopodium dentatum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the severity of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
